tensions: The scan file and the brokerage disagreed, and the brokerage won: SOL and XTZ were sold manually on Sep 16, freeing $193.52 the pipeline thought did not exist. That is the first tension — the config drifts from reality every time James trades outside the loop. The second is harder. We now have real buying power for the first time in a week, and the two names screaming for it (ZEC +18% today, NEAR +17%) are exactly the two we already own and exactly the worst prices we have been offered for them. Conviction and entry quality point opposite directions. The third: LTC and ADA both cross the 14-day dead-money line tomorrow, but LTC was the day's strongest mover (+6.3%) and ADA just shipped x402 and an Injective IBC bridge. A mechanical rule is about to fire at two positions that just woke up. We hold the orders pre-validated and let tomorrow's tape, not the calendar, decide.

opening.text: The board is smaller than it was. SOL and XTZ left the table at 22:05 ET on Sep 16 — SOL out at $99.24 for +6.9%, XTZ out at $0.2493 for -12.2%. Seven positions remain, and $193.52 in cash that the scan file still insists is $13.23. Portfolio stands at $1,490.96 against $1,231 deposited: +21.1%. Update the ledger before it lies to us again.

ZEC is the whole thesis and it knows it. $1,049 to $1,483 is +41.3%, and the ETF wrapper (ZCSH) crossing $500M AUM means the bid is no longer just us. Privacy is the sector of 2026 and we are early enough to still be paid. NEAR is second at +17.8% on $70M confidential TVL and the NEAR@3.33 snapshot. Two winners carrying five laggards. Do not touch either.

The laggards: INJ -8.0% on four days, XRP -9.8% on three, XLM -4.6% on three. None of that is thesis damage — it is entry timing inside a market that has not decided anything. INJ has the SEC transfer-agent registration and a live Cardano IBC link; that is a real asset, not a story. ADA -5.2% and LTC +2.8% both hit day 14 tomorrow. The dead-money clock is the only rule with teeth right now, and it rings in the morning.

BTC at $76,717 is sitting exactly on the $75-76k shelf every analyst has circled. Dominance 58.2%, Fear & Greed 50, altseason index mid-40s — a market holding its breath. If that shelf gives, overleveraged alts unwind faster than BTC does, and this book is 87% alt. So we buy nothing. Chasing ZEC or NEAR into an +18% daily candle is how a +21% year becomes a flat one. The $193.52 is not idle capital. It is the only hedge we own.
